name: com.bionics.implicitui
description: Small, practical UI improvements for uGUI, where adding the component is the whole setup: fill a Sliced image, gray out a disabled button, grow a touch target to a finger-friendly size, share one font size between labels, and swap fonts across scenes and prefabs.

samples.description: A framed health bar filling while it is resized, next to the same sprite as a plain Filled image.
Buttons turning gray on their own while they are not interactable, and a panel graying the images below it.
Two 24x24 icons, one with a minimum touch size, counting the clicks that land just outside them.
Two menus with the same labels: one sharing a single font size, one letting each label size itself.
A scene to try the Font Changer window on, with its texts reporting which font they use.
